verdict.rationale: Sardine's own marketing pages say AI agents clear obvious false positives, do supporting research, and route higher-risk sanctions matches to analysts with explainable scores. It also advertises 'Agentic AML Ops' agents that automate KYC/AML alert reviews and investigations. These are AI-generated recommendations on customer data inside the product, but they are confined to alert triage and backed only by marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: a general AI insights/suggestions or copilot feature across the user's data, in-depth first-party docs on how the AI outputs are shown in the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.
